  ) v(class_name, drug_root)
),
matched_exposures AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cd.class_name, cd.drug_root, de.drug_exposure_id, de.person_id
  FROM class_drugs cd
  JOIN omop.concept c
    ON c.domain_id = 'Drug'
   AND LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%' + cd.drug_root + '%'
  JOIN omop.drug_exposure de
    ON de.drug_concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN ra_patients rp
    ON rp.person_id = de.person_id
),
summary AS (
  SELECT class_name,
         COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS ra_patients_exposed,
         COUNT(DISTINCT drug_exposure_id) AS exposures,
         COUNT(DISTINCT drug_root) AS matched_drug_roots
  FROM matched_exposures

),

SELECT s.class_name,

       CAST(100.0 * s.ra_patients_exposed / NULLIF(d.total_ra_patients,0) AS decimal(5,2)) AS pct_ra_patients,
       s.exposures,
       s.matched_drug_roots,
       d.total_ra_patients
FROM summary s CROSS JOIN den d
ORDER BY s.ra_patients_exposed DESC, s.exposures DESC;
